Name: Holiday Cookies
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Recently I've been developing the largest mod I've ever made - a culmination of every skill I've learned over the course of my mod-making-history... 

But everyone needs breaks now and then - and I had a fair few of these sprites already done so... why not make a silly little mod that adds some sugar cookies!

So I did just that: This mod adds 17 different holiday themed sugar cookies to the game! (I may have made an extra one for Halloween and not wanted to delete it...) Each cookie does something a little different for effects (they only last a minute each) and all of them have gift tastes for NPCs that I thought fit each of them!

Note: I support translation files as well for anyone who wants to do that :] Just make sure to make this mod a requirement for the file! Alternatively, you can provide the pastebin for it and I will add it to the mod!

How to get each recipe:
[spoiler] [b]Mail/Friendship:[/b]
- Pumpkin Sugar Cookie: Get 3 hearts with Sebastian
- Ghost Sugar Cookie: Get 3 hearts with Abigail 
- Confetti Sugar Cookie: Get 3 hearts with Vincent

[b]Saloon:[/b]
- Martini Sugar Cookie

[b]Marnie's Shop:[/b]
- Cat Sugar Cookie
- Bunny Sugar Cookie
- Chick Sugar Cookie

[b]Egg Festival:[/b]
- Easter Egg Sugar Cookie
- Basket Sugar Cookie

[b]Moonlight Jellies:[/b] 
- Party Hat Sugar Cookie

[b]Spirit's Eve Festival:[/b]
- Skull Sugar Cookie
- Witch Hat Sugar Cookie

[b]Winter Star Festival: [/b]
- Winter Star Tree Sugar Cookie
- Present Sugar Cookie
- Ornament Sugar Cookie
- Star Sugar Cookie
- Firework Sugar Cookie [/spoiler]

[i]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things. [/i]
